verdict.rationale:
Cognee is explicitly open source and documented as self-hostable via Docker or pip/uvx install, with runtime probes confirming a working local CLI and MCP server running fully offline without cloud accounts. Pricing page states the full memory engine can run locally or on your own stack 'free, forever,' and docs also allow a fully local UI via start_ui().
missing for 10: independent third-party verification of a production self-hosted deployment beyond the vendor docs/probes.
